note: Names, descriptions and grades are the official PlayStation list as carried in the kit starter (Exophase and PSNProfiles agreeing). kind, missable, stage and count are inferred from the official descriptions only; missable flags are cautious and are labelled as such in the app. Guides are original text written for this entry and cite their sources per trophy.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.searchTerms: platinum legend all trophies 100 percent everything
trophies.guide: This is the platinum: it unlocks on its own the moment the other 54 trophies are all earned, so there is nothing separate to do for it. Treat it as the finish line of the roadmap in this app — clear the story first, sweep the collectibles and activities, then close out 100% completion. If it does not pop, check the tracker for any trophy still unticked, most often a count-based one.
steps: Earn all 54 other trophies.
The platinum unlocks automatically afterwards.

Rob it.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.searchTerms: cocktail ocean beach drink view sunset missable
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. This sounds like a small scripted moment — a drink, a specific beach, a view — and moments like this in the series are often attached to an early story beat, which is why this guide flags it cautiously as missable: if the story puts you on Ocean Beach, take the drink when it is offered rather than rushing on. If free roam allows it later, a bar on Ocean Beach is the first place to try. No cited source confirms it is one-chance; the flag is a caution built from the official description's wording.
steps: Visit Ocean Beach, especially during any story beat there.
Order or accept a cocktail where the view is the point.
Enjoy it to earn the trophy.

trophies.searchTerms: choices decisions 500 made missable consequences
trophies.guide: Choices made, for better or worse — PlayStation tracks a count for this trophy, and the starter list notes the count runs to 500. A tracked count of choices means the game logs decisions you make, and choices are the one thing a linear replay cannot always revisit, so this guide flags it cautiously: make choices deliberately as they arise rather than skipping past them, and expect the total to build across the whole playthrough. If the count stalls, story decisions are the most likely source. Treat the missable flag as a caution from the description's wording, not a confirmed one-chance trophy.
steps: Make every choice the game offers as you play.
Watch the tracked count climb toward 500.

steps: Fail a retryable attempt once.
Succeed on the immediate second attempt.

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.searchTerms: bowling melee drive-by ten pin knock over
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by: knock a person down by striking them from a moving vehicle with a melee attack, rather than running them over. Ride or drive slowly past a pedestrian, swing as you pass, and the hit — not the vehicle — must do the knocking down. A quiet street and a slow pass make the timing much easier than a full-speed attempt.
steps: Get in or on a vehicle with a melee option.
Pass a pedestrian slowly.
Land a melee hit from the vehicle that knocks them down.

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.searchTerms: money laundering marked bills earn cash 250000 wash
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 by laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills are a specific currency earned from certain scores, and only money actually laundered through contacts counts — spending or banked cash does not. Build a routine: take jobs that pay in marked bills, launder after each one, and watch the total here rather than guessing. It is a long-tail economy trophy, best progressed steadily during the story instead of farmed at the end.
steps: Earn Marked Bills from jobs that pay them.
Launder them through your contacts.
Reach $250,000 laundered.
